text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I shall soon be embarking on an overseas expedition.
I would be delighted to bring you back a souvenir, if you would like—is there anything you desire?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... No, I shall leave it to you.
Whatever you choose will surely be far more magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My... Fufu♪ To have you speak of me like that,
I am truly honored.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall pick something out in my own way.
Something that will surely suit you, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, I heard Ruler is also heading out on an expedition.
And Flash-senpai... returned only the other day, was it not?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone is taking flight to distant lands, it seems.
Each carrying their own mission in their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Once you return, let us...
have lots of long chats again, all right?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
About the future we will paint from here on.
About the countless wishes that Rose-san holds so dear to her heart.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Indeed. By all means, please do.
Time spent conversing with you is truly precious.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
But for now... I am cheering for you, Pisa.
I vow that I will be there to watch your running
warm and unite the world.
